items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: And I was in the recording band with Herb — I had to go tell Herb Pomeroy I was leaving school.

ctx.x: Okay so I went back to Berklee. Jimmy Mosher was the alto player who had just gotten off the summer tour with Buddy Rich. He did the “Away We Go” Jackie Gleason special, but he came back to Berklee to teach. So they put me in his ensemble, and I was in for about two weeks. On the second week we all go to a bar afterwards on a Friday night rehearsal — me, Lynn Bivvy — well Lynn had left already. And Lynn had gone on the

road — Lynn Biviano, the trumpet player. And he was out with Woody Herman. And so Jimmy Mosher was hanging out with Johnny in the bar and he said, “You know you’ve been in school too long.” He said, “You should go out on the road.” And we’re all drinking. And he said, “There’s a job opening with Buddy Rich. I’m going to make a call and get you the gig.” This was while we’re all drinking on Friday. So Monday morning comes around and I see Jimmy Mosher and I say, “Okay where’s that gig with Buddy Rich?” He said,…
